subject: Fastest air freight to RUH
body:
Hello,

Our buyer in Riyadh, SA, is importing electronic control units from us in Germany. I am arranging the flight for their import and would appreciate your quote for the fastest option from DUS to RUH.

The goods will be ready on 2026-11-27, and we will deliver them ourselves to Duesseldorf Airport (DUS). The import shipment consists of 11 pieces with a gross weight of 1049 kg and a volume of 4.21 cbm.

Could you please confirm the earliest available flight and arrival at RUH, together with your all-in price in EUR?

Thank you.

Viele Gruesse / Many greetings
Deniz Yilmaz
Rheintal Elektronik GmbH

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting an all-in price and fastest flight option for a new shipment.
